verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Groq serves an llms.txt at console.groq.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs are also available as raw markdown (e.g. /docs/overview.md, and many doc pages served at .md URLs), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs, evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt, and inclusion of the machine-readable API spec in llms.txt (which the evidence says lists no spec).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://console.groq.com/llms.txt # https://console.groq.com llms.txt
